name: writing
description: Drafting discipline for academic prose and email, with your own register loaded before any drafting, and a fresh-context review panel for paper drafts that computes its verdict from finding severities.

academic_register.title: Academic register
academic_register.description: Optional. Full path to your own academic prose register: a Markdown file setting out your voice, punctuation habits, and measured targets, which the academic-prose skill reads before it touches prose. Leave empty to use the generic register bundled with the plugin. A project's own register notes override either.

email_register.title: Email register
email_register.description: Optional. Full path to your own email register: a Markdown file setting out how your emails are shaped, signed, and handed over, which the draft-email skill reads before it drafts. Leave empty to use the generic register bundled with the plugin.
